messages:
lia_partnerships: Quick sync — we need to map all SI enablement assets to the marketplace + HW partner catalog. Goal: single source of truth for 1) playbooks, 2) localized training, 3) cert artifacts.

jfoster: Agree. current problem is duplicates across GDrive + Notion. hard to track which version is live. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

karen_pm: Do we have a canonical schema for catalog entries? tags, locale, audience, cert-level?

lia_partnerships: Not strictly. Proposal: CSV with columns: `asset_id, title, type, locale, owner, cert_level, marketplace_listing, hw_compat` and a `last_review` date.

sam_infra: That works. we should add `deploy_artifact` boolean to mark if it needs infra work for demos.

mikael_sales: Sales needs `partner_ready` flag + `si_playbook_url` for field enablement. Also want quick filter for `hardware_partner` so AE can see compatible configs.

lia_partnerships: ok adding those. Draft CSV header I'll start with:

```
asset_id,title,type,locale,owner,cert_level,marketplace_listing,hw_compat,last_review,deploy_artifact,partner_ready,si_playbook_url
```

content-bot: Created a stub inventory in the partnerships folder: https://drive.redwood/example (doc view). Use this as baseline. :white_check_mark:

jfoster: Next: localization. We should prioritize ja/en/es for pilot. Need translators + acceptance checklist (UI screenshots, command examples, exam questions).

karen_pm: For cert artifacts, add `exam_items` and `practical_lab` fields. Labs must reference a container image or infra template.

lia_partnerships: Good call. Sam — can infra provide a minimal test harness for labs (k8s helm + example values)?

sam_infra: Yup. I'll publish a reference helm chart and an IAM policy snippet. Will link `infra_template_url` in the CSV. ETA EOW.

mikael_sales: Can we also tag which partners are eligible for joint announcement once the SI completes cert? e.g., `joint_announce_ok` field.

lia_partnerships: yep. We'll include `joint_announce_ok` and `announcement_tier` (co-marketing / joint press / partner blog).

jfoster: Suggest workflow: 1) populate CSV -> 2) review by owners (2 business days) -> 3) localization sprint -> 4) publish to marketplace + enable certification badge. Can we automate owner reminders?

content-bot: I can create period reminders and a PR template for updates if you add the CSV to the repo. Use /create-reminder in #partnerships and tag owners.

lia_partnerships: I'll drop the initial CSV into `partnerships/onboarding-inventory.csv` and ping owners. People: please review your owned rows by Tue.

karen_pm: Adding a short acceptance checklist for exam items and lab grading rubric. Will link once done.

mikael_sales: I'll capture the partner announcement playbook outline and criteria for `joint_announce_ok` — want to avoid premature press.

jfoster: Thanks — this should finally reduce the duplication mess. small ask: add a `deprecation_policy` column to flag retired assets so we don't accidentally certify on old material.

lia_partnerships: done. will send updated CSV link in 10. :rocket:
